findings.title: [Security] CI contract misses pytest options persisted between steps
findings.problem: The validator rejects PYTEST_ADDOPTS in workflow/job/required-step env mappings but does not inspect values written to GITHUB_ENV by earlier steps. GitHub Actions propagates those values to the required pytest command, so a future step could persist an option that excludes the structural tests while the validator still accepts the workflow. The checked-in workflow has no detected setter; this is a guard gap, not an active bypass.
findings.current_code: for scope in (ci, job): environment = scope.get("env", {}); reject direct PYTEST_ADDOPTS/GITHUB_ACTIONS keys
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the policy and mutation tests to cover prior-step GITHUB_ENV writes, or require a test invocation that explicitly clears inherited PYTEST_ADDOPTS.

findings.title: [Standards] Reuse drift assertions through a helper, not pytest test functions
findings.problem: The multi-version case invokes other pytest test functions and temporarily replaces the module-level loader to reuse their setup and assertions, coupling test entry points and signatures.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract reusable ordinary assertion/fixture helpers with explicit validator and temporary-directory parameters.
